'''Dal Calain''' was a kingdom of the [[Third Age#The Free Years|Free Years]]. It arose from the ruins of [[Coremanda]] after the [[Trolloc Wars]]. Its territory is currently unclaimed by any modern nation.

==Geography==
[[Image:Dal Calain.png|thumb|right|200px|In red location within the Westlands]]

Dal Calain was bordered by the [[River Haevin]] to the west and north, the [[Arinelle]] to the south, another tributary of the Arinelle to the southeast, and the [[Black Hills]] in the northeast. In the east the territory of Dal Calain opened up onto the plains of [[Caralain Grass]]. Its neighbors were [[Masenashar]] to the west and north, [[Roemalle]] in the far northeast, [[Caembarin]] to the east, [[Aldeshar]] to the south, and [[Farashelle]] to the southwest.

==History==
Little is known of Dal Calain, save that at one time it was ruled by Queen [[Isebele]], who was powerful and willful enough to summon the then-[[Amyrlin Seat|Amyrlin]] [[Anghara]] to visit her for an audience. Dal Calain avoided being conquered during the [[War of the Second Dragon]], although neighboring Farashelle did fall to the [[false Dragon]] [[Guaire Amalasan]]. Dal Calain was later conquered by [[Artur Paendrag Tanreall|Artur Hawkwing]] during [[the Conquest]] and made part of his [[Artur Hawkwing's Empire|empire]].

==Addendum==
In ''[[A Crown of Swords]]'' [[Mat Cauthon]] incorrectly recalls that Dal Calain was destroyed in the Trolloc Wars. More accurately, it was conquered by Artur Hawkwing and whatever attempts were made to refound it after his death were interrupted by the [[War of the Hundred Years]]. The same mistake is repeated in TWoTC where it is stated that Dal Calain disappeared during the Trolloc Wars while instead it was born exactly after the same wars.
